title: ShieldCare Premium Invoices: the Charge for Raising the Invoice
content:
## The charge

A charge for raising a premium invoice on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan arises where no automatic
payment instruction stands on the store credit account the profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts. Its size turns on whether the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary
queue.

| What the records show | The charge for raising the invoice |
| --- | --- |
| no automatic payment instruction stands on the store credit account, and the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | 15.00 |
| no automatic payment instruction stands on that account, and the plan is not one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | 7.50 |
| every other profile | no charge for raising the invoice is added |

## Points of judgement

Where an automatic payment instruction does stand on the account, no charge is added at all, whatever the
plan's queue position. Where none stands, the queue position of the plan is the whole of the difference
between 15.00 and 7.50.

## Cases on hypothetical records

| Automatic payment instruction on the account | Claims worked ahead of the queue | Charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing | no | none |
| standing | yes | none |
| none | no | 7.50 |
| none | yes | 15.00 |
